*Fan favorite Drac ‘A Rita is back alongside a revamped Draco Taco and all-new Draco’rrito, plus the chance to scare up free tacos for a year on National Taco Day*


IRVING, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 21, 2026--[Fuzzy's Taco Shop](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fuzzystacoshop.com%2F&esheet=54606937&newsitemid=20260921257471&lan=en-US&anchor=Fuzzy%27s+Taco+Shop&index=1&md5=2bb48a5d980c0b3d463f3cc3072a80ac) , the restaurant brand known for serving up delicious tacos, innovative drinks and good vibes, is bringing back its legendary Halloween menu for another round of mayhem. Available September 21 through November 8, the creeptacular spread reimagines the Draco Taco and introduces the Draco’rrito and Midnight Matador to the mix.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260921257471/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260921257471/en/)


Fuzzy’s Taco Shop® Brings Back its Draco Line-Up with a Brand-New Bite This Halloween


The sequel takes everything that made the Draco Taco and Drac ‘A Rita a hit the first time around and sinks its teeth in even deeper for round two. Whether guests prefer their Halloween rolled, folded, dipped, frozen or on the rocks, Fuzzy’s is ready to feed the fright with vampiro-style sauce back at the center of the action and plenty of heat, crunch and after-dark mischief to go around:


- **Draco Taco II ($4.69):** The legend bares its fangs again, this time with a crispy red shell tucked inside a melted cheese-topped flour tortilla, filled with seasoned ground beef, garlic sauce, spicy vampiro-style sauce, avocado, feta, cilantro and lime.†
- **Draco’rrito ($10.25):** A flour tortilla rolled with a crispy cheese crust and stuffed with cheese, seasoned ground beef, Fuzzy’s rice, vampiro-style sauce, sour cream, vampiro queso and crispy red tortilla strips.†
- **Drac a ‘Rita ($9.25):** A frozen favorite dressed for the occasion, featuring **** Fuzzy’s house frozen margarita swirled with Bacardi rum and strawberry puree, rimmed with black salt and garnished with a set of vampire teeth.*
- **Midnight Matador ($11.69):** Casamigos Blanco Tequila, triple sec, margarita mix and blood orange for a citrusy sip made for raising a little havoc.*


Prefer your Halloween plans with fewer fangs? A **$5 Modelo draft** beer keeps things classic while Draco is in town.*


“Draco has always been about going a little over the top, and we leaned into that even more this year,” said Chef Daniel Camp, Director of Culinary for Fuzzy’s Taco Shop. “We brought back that heat from the vampiro sauce and layered in plenty of crunch and cheese, then took it one step further with the Draco’rrito, our boldest take on Draco yet.”


**Scratch If You Dare: National Taco Day Just Got Bigger**


On October 6, Fuzzy’s is making National Taco Day a win for everyone with **$2 Original Tacos** *†* **** all day and a limited-edition scratch-off card guaranteed to reveal a reward.** Rewards members can score free chips and queso, taco deals and more, while a lucky few will scratch their way to the grand prize of **free tacos for a year** .***


To check out the full menu and find a Fuzzy's Taco Shop location near you, visit[www.fuzzystacoshop.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.fuzzystacoshop.com&esheet=54606937&newsitemid=20260921257471&lan=en-US&anchor=www.fuzzystacoshop.com&index=2&md5=bf885612edf20d54694776de0ea2d779) .

**About Fuzzy’s Taco Shop**


Founded in 2003 in Fort Worth, Texas, Fuzzy’s Taco Shop® is a fast-casual plus restaurant known for fresh flavors and good vibes that take the bite out of life. Offering flavorful tacos, famous margaritas, and fun times, it's all fuzzy here. As of June 28, 2026, Fuzzy's operates 97 restaurants across 15 states, including one company-owned location in Texas. Fuzzy’s Taco Shop is franchised by affiliates of Pasadena, Calif.-based Dine Brands Global, Inc. (NYSE: DIN). To find your local Fuzzy’s Taco Shop, visit[Fuzzystacoshop.com/locations](http://fuzzystacoshop.com/locations) . For franchising information, visit[Franchise.fuzzystacoshop.com](http://franchise.fuzzystacoshop.com/) .


**About Dine Brands Global, Inc.**


Based in Pasadena, California, Dine Brands Global, Inc. (NYSE: DIN), through its subsidiaries and franchisees, supports and operates restaurants under the Applebee's Neighborhood Grill + Bar®, IHOP®, and Fuzzy’s Taco Shop® brands. As of June 28, 2026, these three brands comprised nearly 3,500 restaurants. Dine Brands is one of the largest full-service restaurant companies in the world and in 2022 expanded into the Fast Casual segment. For more information on Dine Brands, visit the Company’s website located at[www.dinebrands.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.dinebrands.com&esheet=54606937&newsitemid=20260921257471&lan=en-US&anchor=www.dinebrands.com&index=3&md5=df65835d8c5d473e0dc0fb2f37956e24) .
